verdict.rationale: Gmail's own Gemini feature lets users operate the mailbox with natural-language requests, such as asking it to delete multiple emails or add labels. It can also summarize threads, draft or refine emails, and propose meeting times. The evidence shows only these example actions, so how much of the product can be driven this way is unproven. Missing for 10: documented breadth of natural-language control beyond the listed examples (e.g., filters, settings, search, sending), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the commands work reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
Summarize: Synthesize long email threads into concise bullet points. Draft: Create new emails or refine existing drafts for tone and clarity.
Schedule: Propose meeting times based on your availability in Google Calendar.
